get_opcodes_diff: generate opcodes representing insertions, deletions, and replacements between two strings using CSequenceMatcher
apply_opcodes_transform: apply a list of opcodes to a substring of source text to produce the modified result
pretty_print_diff_output: pretty print the difference between a source and target string showing each edit operation
source_target_to_diffs_pairs: convert a source and target string into a list of unique source to target diff pairs
source_diffs_to_target_apply: apply a list of source target diff pairs to transform a source string into the target
